events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival
events.source: Visit Sunshine Coast / The Urban List
events.description: A ten-day arts and culture festival featuring theatre, comedy, ballet, literary talks, art exhibitions, and food experiences across Noosa, aimed at diverse audiences.

events.title: Sunshine Coast Collective Markets
events.location: Coolum State Primary School, Coolum Beach
events.description: A community market held on the fourth Sunday of the month, featuring local makers, art, design, fashion, food stalls, and family-friendly activities.

events.title: Winter Pademelon Survey
events.description: Participate in a citizen-science wildlife survey focused on pademelons at the beautiful Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve, contributing to local environmental understanding.

events.title: Kundalini Activation & Breathwork Group Session
events.description: A guided group session focused on kundalini activation and breathwork practices, offered at a local wellness studio for those seeking grounded movement and meditation.
